column1: # huge_app.csv has a single 3MB app slot and NO ota_1 partition
# POST /api/ota fails at Update.begin() on those layouts. This table trades
# the coredump partition and most of SPIFFS for two maximal OTA slots.
# App slots are 0x1F0000 (1984KB) each — check your firmware.bin fits.
# SPIFFS is 64KB: plenty for config.json + fleet.json
# Switching tables relocates SPIFFS: first flash must go over USB and
# re-provisions WiFi/pool config; OTA works from then on.
